        return 0;

## 📊 Quiz Scoring Guide

| Score | Interpretation |
|-------|---------------|
| **90–100%** | Strong understanding. Move to the next chapter. |
| **70–89%** | Good understanding. Review missed concepts briefly, then proceed. |
| **50–69%** | Surface understanding. Review the chapter again, especially missed areas. |
| **< 50%** | Concepts haven't clicked yet. Re-read the chapter, retype all examples, retake the quiz. |

*Target score: 70% or higher to proceed.*
